verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's changelog documents a first-party 'Secret variables in environments' feature, which addresses the masked-secrets branch of the story. The evidence is only a single changelog line, though. It does not show that secret values are masked in the UI or excluded from shared or exported environments and collections, and no external vault integration is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation that secrets are masked and kept out of shared or synced files, external vault integration (e.g. HashiCorp Vault, AWS or Azure secret managers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can keep credentials out of shared files with masked secrets or an external vault integration
